"""Owned focused historical-admission review; no model checkpoint execution."""
from __future__ import annotations
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import signal
import subprocess
import time

ROOT = Path('/Users/teilomillet/Code/wyat')
OUT = Path('/private/tmp/wyat-prefix-history-review')
OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
FILES = ('benchmarks/analysis/torch/prefix/pairs.py', 'benchmarks/analysis/torch/prefix/memory/study.py', 'benchmarks/analysis/torch/prefix/latency/study.py', 'tests/analysis/test_cpu_prefix_history.py')
def hashes() -> dict[str, str]:
    return {p: hashlib.sha256((ROOT/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in FILES}
command = [str(ROOT/'.venv/bin/python'), '-m', 'pytest', '-q', 'tests/analysis/test_cpu_prefix_history.py', 'tests/analysis/test_cpu_prefix_pairs.py', 'tests/analysis/test_cpu_prefix_memory.py', 'tests/analysis/test_cpu_prefix_latency.py']
before = hashes()
started = time.monotonic()
p = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=ROOT, text=True, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT, start_new_session=True)
timed_out = False
try:
    stdout, _ = p.communicate(timeout=60)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
    timed_out = True
    os.killpg(p.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
    stdout, _ = p.communicate()
wall = time.monotonic()-started
(OUT/'stdout.txt').write_text(stdout)
receipt = {'command':command, 'cap_seconds':60, 'exit_code':p.returncode,'reaped':p.poll() is not None,'wall_seconds':wall,'timed_out':timed_out,'before':before,'after':hashes()}
(OUT/'receipt.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n')
print(stdout)
print(json.dumps(receipt))
